{{Top}}
A '''planet hopper''', '''planet skipper''', or '''interplanetary hopper'''<ref name="FBS">''[[Flashpoint! Brak Sector]]''</ref> was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] capable of transit from one [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to another within the same [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. Planet-hoppers had no [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. The ''[[Light of Reason]]'' was a planet-hopper.
